name: Move Blinkit data to Azure Synapse Analytics
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Blinkit** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Azure Synapse Analytics data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Blinkit** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Client ID** and **Refresh Token.** Their details can be found [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/blinkit/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
